description: This PHP source file defines the LeaveTypeDao class, which provides database access methods for managing LeaveType entities within the OrangeHRM leave management system. It contains methods for CRUD operations, search, and other specific queries related to leave types.

classes.name: LeaveTypeDao
classes.description: DAO class for managing LeaveType entities, providing methods to retrieve, save, delete, undelete, and search leave types in the database.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all non-deleted LeaveType entities, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Fetches a LeaveType entity by its primary key ID.

methods.name: getExistingLeaveTypeIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing active leave types matching a list of IDs.

methods.name: saveLeaveType
methods.description: Persists a LeaveType entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteLeaveType
methods.description: Marks specified leave types as deleted.

methods.name: getDeletedLeaveTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves list of leave types marked as deleted.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeByName
methods.description: Fetches a leave type entity by name, considering only non-deleted entries.

methods.name: undeleteLeaveType
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted leave type by setting its deleted flag to false.

methods.name: searchLeaveType
methods.description: Performs a search for leave types based on filter parameters, returning matching leave types.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypePaginator
methods.description: Builds and returns a paginator object for leave type search results based on filters.

methods.name: getSearchLeaveTypesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of leave types matching search filter criteria.

methods.name: hasEmployeeAllocatedLeavesForLeaveType
methods.description: Checks if an employee has allocated leaves for a specific leave type.
